inspiration: 16x16 pixel art written as text grids over a small palette; a readable silhouette and a dark keyline carry each creature (win/share/monsters.txt:33).
Sex/size variants are one silhouette with a size and body-shape change, not a new design (win/share/monsters.txt:53-54).
A generic 'strange object' tile (win/share/objects.txt:33) keeps unknown loot from rendering blank.
Decals are small overlays merged on top of a base tile at draw time (win/share/decals.txt:2): a cheap status-rim technique.
Found-sound creak clips each pitched to a note, so a few clips make a tune (sound/wav/attributions.txt:5).
Mines fill is one generator call that smooths, joins and walls a cave region, then a spawn list (dat/minefill.lua:17, :37-40).
Flavour lines live in plain text tables drawn at random (dat/rumors.tru, dat/epitaph.txt): cheap flavour system for hub or loot messages.
